description: TranscriptAPI provides programmatic access to YouTube transcripts, video metadata, search, channel browsing, and playlist listing. It offers these capabilities through a REST API and a Model Context Protocol server for AI assistants.
summary: TranscriptAPI exposes two developer integration surfaces on transcriptapi.com: a REST API at `https://transcriptapi.com/api/v2` authenticated with a bearer API key, and an OAuth-protected MCP server at `https://transcriptapi.com/mcp` that supports self-onboarding via Dynamic Client Registration plus a documented API-key fallback.
